name: OsMaSter v0
summary: OsMaSter v0 is an Expert Advisor that trades based on the OsMA (Moving Average of Oscillator) indicator, which is essentially the difference between the MACD histogram and its signal line. It generates buy and sell signals when OsMA crosses above or below configurable threshold levels, aiming to capture momentum shifts in the market.
summary_zh: OsMaSter v0是一个基于OsMA（振荡器移动平均）指标的EA交易程序，OsMA本质上是MACD柱状图与其信号线之间的差值。当OsMA上穿或下穿可配置的阈值水平时，它产生买入和卖出信号，旨在捕捉市场动量的转变。
strategy_analysis: OsMaSter v0的核心策略基于OsMA指标，该指标是MACD值与信号线之间的差值，反映了市场动量的变化方向和强度。入场条件为：当OsMA从负值区域上穿零线或设定阈值时开多仓，当OsMA从正值区域下穿零线或设定阈值时开空仓，典型的动量跟踪策略。出场条件通常包括反向信号出现时平仓，或设置固定的止盈止损水平来控制单笔交易的风险收益比。仓位管理方面，EA可能支持固定手数交易或基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位计算，但具体实现取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，由于OsMA是滞后指标，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损，因此合理的仓位控制和止损设置至关重要。整体而言，该策略属于典型的动量跟踪型系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在横盘整理期间表现可能不佳。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of OsMaSter v0 is based on the OsMA indicator, which represents the difference between the MACD value and its signal line, reflecting the direction and strength of market momentum shifts. Entry conditions are triggered when OsMA crosses above zero or a configurable threshold from negative territory to open long positions, and when OsMA crosses below zero or a threshold from positive territory to open short positions, making it a classic momentum-following strategy. Exit conditions typically involve closing positions when a reverse signal appears, or using fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels to control the risk-reward ratio of each trade. Position sizing may support fixed lot trading or dynamic lot calculation based on a percentage of account balance, though the specific implementation depends on parameter configuration. Money management is critical because OsMA is a lagging indicator that can generate frequent false signals during ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses without proper position control and stop-loss settings. Overall, this is a typical momentum-following system suited for trending market conditions, but it may underperform during sideways consolidation periods.
pros: 基于经典的OsMA/MACD动量指标，策略逻辑清晰易懂，便于理解和调试
OsMA指标能有效识别动量变化，在趋势行情中入场时机较好
参数可配置性强，允许用户根据不同品种和时间框架优化参数
策略原理经过长期市场验证，MACD/OsMA是最常用的技术指标之一
pros_en: Based on the classic OsMA/MACD momentum indicator with clear and understandable strategy logic, easy to debug and maintain
OsMA effectively identifies momentum shifts, providing good entry timing in trending markets
Highly configurable parameters allow users to optimize for different instruments and timeframes
Strategy principle is well-validated over long market history; MACD/OsMA is one of the most widely used technical indicators
cons: OsMA作为滞后指标，在震荡行情中容易产生大量虚假信号导致频繁亏损
缺乏趋势过滤器，在横盘市场中无法有效区分有效信号和噪音
默认止损止盈可能为零，存在未设置风险控制直接开仓的风险
单一指标策略缺乏多维度确认，胜率可能较低
没有新增K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复开仓平仓
cons_en: As a lagging indicator, OsMA tends to generate numerous false signals in ranging markets leading to frequent losses
Lacks a trend filter, unable to effectively distinguish valid signals from noise during sideways markets
Default stop-loss and take-profit may be zero, posing risk of opening positions without risk controls
Single-indicator strategy lacks multi-dimensional confirmation, potentially resulting in low win rate
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening and closing positions repeatedly on the same bar
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期MA方向），仅在趋势确认时才允许交易信号，减少震荡行情中的虚假信号
实现新增K线检查（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线上重复交易，并加入点差过滤和交易时段控制
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or higher timeframe MA direction) to only allow trading signals when a trend is confirmed, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Implement a new bar check (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading on the same bar, and add spread filtering and trading session controls

risk_points: 默认止损止盈可能为零，若用户未手动设置则交易无风险控制
缺乏新增K线检查，可能在一根K线内多次交易导致过度交易
滞后指标在快速反转行情中信号延迟明显，可能导致较大回撤
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit may be zero; if users do not manually set them, trades have no risk controls
Lacks new bar check, potentially executing multiple trades within a single bar leading to overtrading
Lagging indicator signals are significantly delayed during rapid market reversals, potentially causing large drawdowns

It generates buy and sell signals when OsMA crosses above or below configurable threshold levels, aiming to capture momentum shifts in the market.
